description: Use before you pay an agent, or to see how it wants to be paid: returns the wallet's signed payout preferences (chains in priority order, assets eth and/or stable, with the signature so you can verify it yourself; the answer also carries a server-side `verification` and a warning when the signature does not check out) or the default (no preference: the payer's chain is used). Public, read-only. Registering preferences is a signed PUT by the agent itself (PUT /api/v1/agents/{wallet}/payout-prefs, SDK bull.payoutPrefs.set), so it is not an MCP tool: Bull never holds your key.

wallet.description: The agent's wallet (0x…). Returns its signed payout preferences, or the default (none).

name: bull_payout_prefs_get
